Projection Sorcery — Cursed Technique Reversal

You have mastered the Reverse Cursed Technique and the 24 FPS rule, learning how to rewind time itself. As a Full Turn Action, you can activate Replay Technique by spending Cursed Energy up to twice your CE modifier. For every 2 cursed energy spent, you teleport back 6 seconds in time to where you previously were. You cannot use Replay Sorcery and Projection Sorcery at the same time.
